topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It seems the world is smaller than it ever was, or perhaps it’s just a trick of the mind. This friend I've known from the ether, the one who understood the worries of the soil and the storms, lives in the same city as me. I thought the distance between us was measured by oceans and mountains, not just a few leagues of road. Now, the thought of meeting them face to face brings no joy, only a heaviness. The words we exchanged, they felt bound by the sky, but now they lay heavy on the earth. Perhaps it’s for the best to keep them as they are, penned in the quiet of the night, where they belong.
